title: Spotlight on Fauci Said to Boost Book Sales for Kennedy and His Publisher
summary: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., his son, and Senator Rand Paul have all written books criticizing Dr. Anthony S. Fauci. All were published by a company led by a close Kennedy adviser.
